preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABC' for c in stdin.splitlines()[0])
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 1000) representing the number of test cases.
The input contains exactly t + 1 lines: the first line is t, and the next t lines are the test case strings.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) >= 1 and len(s) <= 50 for s in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case string s consists of capital letters 'A', 'B', and 'C' only, with length between 1 and 50 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(['YES' if (count_A := s.count('A')) == (count_C := s.count('C')) and count_B >= abs(count_A - count_C) else 'NO' for s in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
postconditions.description: For each test case string s, the output is 'YES' if and only if the number of 'A's equals the number of 'C's (count_A == count_C) and the number of 'B's is at least the absolute difference between count_A and count_C (count_B >= abs(count_A - count_C)). This ensures that all letters can be erased by pairing 'A's with 'B's and 'C's with 'B's in some sequence.
